claude_proposed_widenings.name: cunning_strike_option
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Cunning Strike options are not standalone activated features. They are embedded choices made at Sneak Attack resolution time, cost Sneak Attack dice from the ongoing pool, have no separate activation, no use_count, and no rest-reset cadence. The activation family (activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect) does not model this trigger pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following Cunning Strike option. Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: sneak_attack_dice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cost 'N Sneak Attack dice' is not representable in ClassFeatureActivationCost (free | bonus_action). A die-pool-from-feature cost variant is needed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: suppress_condition_removal
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect suppresses the automatic removal of the Invisible condition that would normally occur after making an attack. ClassFeatureEffect (grant_extra_action | heal_hp) has no variant for condition-removal suppression.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover
